invariants.description: Lineage graph MUST be a DAG; cycles are a constitutional violation.
All graph ledger entries MUST form an unbroken HMAC-SHA256 chain.
Committed nodes and edges are append-only; no edits or deletes.
Every node MUST be anchored to a specific phase, version, and gate.
Full ancestry path from any node to GENESIS MUST be computable in O(N).
HUMAN-0 holds sole authority to seal a lineage snapshot or purge a ghost node.
Each edge MUST carry the gate type it represents.
All graph operations logged with ISO-8601 timestamps and actor attribution.
Root-cause path for any rollback MUST be resolvable via the lineage graph.
